chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
We require an automated and standardized process to generate UPC (Universal Product Code) and GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) values for Walmart orders.
To support Walmart's compliance requirements, Shahi must ensure that valid and unique UPC/GTIN numbers are generated and associated with each applicable SKU.
These identifiers are used across various trims that are physically procured and applied to garments, including wash care labels, generic tags, size strips, RFID hangtags, and UPC stickers. Depending on the sourcing model, these trims are procured from approved vendors such as AD and RPAC,
chunks.locator: § Business Requirement

chunks.title: Introduction of new menu as UPC & GTIN Configurator as Form Type
chunks.heading: Scope › Introduction of new menu as UPC & GTIN Configurator as Form Type
chunks.text:
Company Setup >> Techpack Setting >> Techpack Form
After we enable this Form type same need to enable on Techpack master.
• The Techpack Forms displayed in any Techpack shall be managed through the Techpack Form Setting. This applies to both newly created Techpacks and existing Techpacks.
• If a Techpack Form is marked as Default in the Techpack Form Setting, the system shall automatically add that form when a new Techpack is created. Additionally, the Default Name configured for the form shall be displayed in the Techpack instead of the original Techpack Form name.
If user click on ‘UPC & GTIN Configurator’ on Techpack below screen need to visible: -
• Button-level permissions (Generate UPC / Generate Assortment UPC / Generate GTIN)
• Checkbox freeze after UPC generation
Once a Color/Size cell's checkbox is used to generate a UPC, that checkbox becomes disabled (greyed out, unchecked).
• Generate Assortment UPC popup logic
User enters a count N (e.g. 10) → system creates N synthetic "colors" named AS1...AS10, each carrying the full-size range as comma-separated values (S, M, L, XL, XXL).
• GTIN generation from generated UPC records
chunks.locator: § Scope › Introduction of new menu as UPC & GTIN Configurator as Form Type

chunks.title: Introduction of new menu as UPC & GTIN Configurator as Form Type
chunks.heading: Scope › Introduction of new menu as UPC & GTIN Configurator as Form Type
chunks.text:
After UPC or Assortment UPC records exist in the "Generated UPC & GTIN Details" grid, user picks a Prefix (Store 30 / Online 20), selects rows via the row checkboxes, then clicks Generate GTIN — which populates the respective GTIN Store (30) or GTIN Online (20) column.
• GTIN freeze per prefix
If a row already has a GTIN Store (30) value, that row's checkbox becomes unselect able for further Store (30) generation — but presumably remains selectable for Online (20) if that column is still blank, and vice versa. This confirms Store/Online are tracked as independent completion flags per row, not a single "GTIN generated" flag.
• Form Type UPC & GTIN Configurator not able to delete from the Techpack master if there is any ‘Generated UPC’ or ‘Generated Assortment UPC’ record exist.
• UPC Number (Generate UPC & Generate Assortment UPC) Generation Logic
• First six character of UPC number are vendor code provided from Walmart to Shahi and it is fixed ‘887512’.
• Next five numbers are running sequence which started from 1 and now reached at 59000 in M3(Shahi Current System).
• Last digit calculations are mentioned below
